description: This header file defines a class 'em_cmd_client_cap_report_t' that inherits from 'em_cmd_t', used for reporting client capabilities in a wireless mesh context. The class contains a constructor that takes command parameters and a mutable reference to a data structure 'dm_easy_mesh_t'. It includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: em_cmd_client_cap_report_t
classes.description: A class derived from em_cmd_t for reporting client capabilities based on provided command parameters and updating the easy mesh data structure.

methods.name: em_cmd_client_cap_report_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report with command parameters and a reference to the easy mesh data structure.
